title: Sweeney Todd
wpTitle: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street Broadway Reviews

ratings.excerpt: Dazzling Broadway revival … Josh Groban and Annaleigh Ashford play Stephen Sondheim’s murderous Victorian couple in a bold and barnstorming take … Thomas Kail’s sumptuous Broadway revival … Groban seldom reveals the depths of rage, trauma and mania that make a monster of this man. It’s a close-shave approach to the role: clean and precise, it doesn’t pierce the surface. … If Groban comes across as flat, his voice, which thrums with menace, embraces every given note. As Mrs Lovett, Annaleigh Ashford, one of Broadway’s great comedians, makes soiled hay of every joke and rhyme.
